newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek short depos firm, ecu/drs ranges, bonds flat.
newsitem.headline: Greek short depos firm, ecu/drs ranges, bonds flat.

text.p: Greek short-term depos were trading a tenth of a point higher around mid-session and forex forwards were generally holding Wednesday afternoon levels, traders said.
Coupon bonds and FRNs were fluctuating in narrow bands and ecu/drachma was hovering around 309.50.

"Short-term depos opened 10 basis points higher and are currently holding morning levels," said a dealer at a private bank. "Forex forwards are also steady but for a rise in tomnext and a slight drop in long tenors."
Bond dealers said prices were frozen and trading activity was subdued with fewer sellers in the market.

"We must have hit a bottom low and players seem unwilling to sell at current levels," said a bond trader at a private bank. "FRNs sell at 120 basis points over the 12-month T-bill and investors prefer to hold on to them rather than unload them."
The mark was quoted at 156.32/37 from Wednesday's 156.080 fix, the dollar at 285.52/62 drachmas from 285.420 and the ecu at 309.50/55 from 309.41 drachmas.
"The market is very quiet. It opened around 309.55 but eased to 309.45 before rising again to 309.50/55," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank.
